description: This file defines the CourseRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to provide database access methods for the Course entity. It includes custom query methods findByCode and findByOwnerId.

classes.name: CourseRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing Course entities with Spring Data JPA.

methods.name: findByCode
methods.description: Finds a Course entity by its code, returning an Optional containing the Course if found.

methods.name: findByOwnerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Course entities associated with a specific owner ID.
